title: Implement Timeline History Cleanup Engine [Recover documentation lost during compiler trap]
summary: Build a safe 'Clean Up History' mechanism that squashes old Git checkpoints to reduce bloat, while simultaneously deleting those nodes from timeline_history.json to prevent UI crashes.
verifiedNotes:
- Add a 'Clean Up History' button to the Timeline UI that triggers the cleanup sequence.
- Implement Git squashing logic that isolates the most recent N checkpoints (e.g., 50), and permanently squashes all older commits into a single baseline commit to reduce repository bloat.
- Update the UI JSON logic to synchronously delete the squashed timeline nodes from timeline_history.json, ensuring users cannot click 'Restore' on hashes that no longer exist.
- Summary not created, I think it is due to there being compile errors and it not writing notes before trying to resolve compile errors resulting in the latest_notes.json information getting lost.
- Clean up History, we need to have this be connected to commit or checkpoint
